bootstrap: Upstream wraps each command in an inline node -e root resolver (plugin-hook-bootstrap.js, an in-process dispatcher require, or a spawnSync wrapper) that searches ~/.claude for an ECC install. An item folder keeps scripts/hooks and scripts/lib, which find their root from their own location, so the item runs the script the wrapper would run. Dropped with the wrapper: its 30 s inner child limit (300 s for stop:format-typecheck; the registered timeout still applies), its stdout suppression of echoed hook input, and the PostToolUse dispatcher's ECC_POSTTOOLUSE_PASSTHROUGH echo.

hooks.translation: The registered bootstrap finds its root only under ~/.claude, never its own folder; the item runs the command that bootstrap spawns.
